description: Install the Gemini CLI (@google/gemini-cli) into ~/.npm-global on the remote — no root. Installs a user-local Node.js 22 under ~/.local/node first if the server has no Node 20+. Adds both to PATH via ~/.bashrc.

steps.description: Install a user-local Node.js 22 under ~/.local/node (skipped if Node 20+ is already available).
steps.run: set -e; ARCH=$(uname -m); case "$ARCH" in x86_64) A=x64;; aarch64|arm64) A=arm64;; *) echo "Unsupported arch: $ARCH"; exit 1;; esac; V=v22.14.0; cd /tmp; curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/$V/node-$V-linux-$A.tar.gz" -o node.tgz; rm -rf "$HOME/.local/node"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/node"; tar -xzf node.tgz -C "$HOME/.local/node" --strip-components=1; rm -f node.tgz; grep -q '.local/node/bin' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$HOME/.local/node/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; "$HOME/.local/node/bin/node" --version

steps.description: Install @google/gemini-cli into ~/.npm-global (user-level npm prefix, no sudo).
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$HOME/.local/node/bin:$PATH"; npm config set prefix "$HOME/.npm-global"; npm install -g @google/gemini-cli; grep -q '.npm-global/bin' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; gemini --version || true
